description: March in place to raise the pulse, swinging the arms naturally. Keep a tall chest and soft knees.
Make smooth circles with the arms, first forward and then back. Keep the ribs down and do not shrug.
Hold a wall and swing one leg forward and back from the hip. Keep the torso still and the swings controlled.
Push the hips back with soft knees and a flat back, then stand tall. Feel the work in the hips, not a rounded spine.
Lie on the back with bent knees and lift the hips, then lower with control. Squeeze the glutes at the top and do not overarch.
Sit the hips back and down to a comfortable depth, then stand tall. Keep the knees tracking over mid-foot.
Hold a light band at shoulder height and pull it apart, then return slowly. Squeeze the shoulder blades and do not shrug.
Stand up from a chair without using the hands, then sit down slowly. Keep the chest tall and a comfortable depth.
Hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend, then return to standing. Keep the back flat and move from the hips.
Hold one dumbbell at the chest and squat to a comfortable depth. Keep the heels down and the elbows inside the knees.
Hold dumbbells, push the hips back, and slide the weights down the legs, then stand tall. Keep soft knees and a flat back.
Step back, lower until the back knee hovers, then push up through the front foot. Keep the torso tall and the front knee over mid-foot.
Place a dumbbell on the hips, drive through the heels, and lift, then lower slowly. Pause at the top and do not arch the low back.
Step onto a low, stable step with the whole foot, stand tall, and step down with control. Push through the heel and do not bounce off the back foot.
Place the hands on a bench or counter and lower the chest, then press up. Keep the body in one line from head to heels.
From the knees, lower the chest with control, then press up. Keep a straight line from head to knees and the elbows about 45 degrees.
Lie on the back and press dumbbells up, then lower until the upper arms touch the floor. Keep the elbows about 45 degrees and do not bounce.
Hinge with a flat back and pull one elbow toward the hip, then lower slowly. Do not twist the torso or shrug.
Anchor a band and pull the elbows back, then return slowly. Squeeze the shoulder blades and keep the ribs down.
Press dumbbells straight up, then lower with control. Keep the ribs down and do not arch the low back.
Lean the back on a wall and hold a shallow bend, about 45 to 60 degrees. Keep the knees over mid-foot, breathe, and do not drop to thighs-parallel in the knee group.
Lie on the back, tighten the thigh, and lift the straight leg to the height of the other bent knee, then lower in about 3 seconds. Keep the low back down.
Anchor a band behind the knee and straighten the leg against the band with a gentle quad squeeze. Do not snap the knee backward.
Place a mini band around the legs and take small steps sideways. Keep the toes forward, a slight knee bend, and the knees from caving in.
Anchor a band and curl one heel toward the glute, then lower slowly. Keep the hips still.
Support the knee over a rolled towel and straighten the leg, then lower slowly. Squeeze the thigh at the top without snapping the knee.
Lie on the side and lift the top leg, leading slightly with the heel, then lower slowly. Keep the hips stacked and do not roll backward.
Lie on the side with a light band above the knees, feet together, and open the top knee. Keep the hips still.
Stand tall with a band and slowly kick one leg out to the side, then return. Keep the working knee soft and the torso quiet.
Curl the dumbbells without swinging, then lower in about 3 seconds. Keep the elbows close to the sides.
Curl with the palms facing in and the elbows pinned. Do not lean or swing the weights.
Stand on a band and curl the handles toward the shoulders, then lower slowly. Keep the elbows pinned and the torso still.
Lower one dumbbell behind the head, then straighten the arms. Keep the elbows forward and the ribs down, and switch to a pressdown if the shoulder pinches.
Anchor a band high and straighten the elbows, then return slowly. Keep the upper arms still and do not snap the elbows.
Hinge with a flat back, keep the upper arm still, and straighten the elbow, then return slowly. Do not swing the weight.
Walk or march in place at an easy pace until breathing settles. Keep the shoulders relaxed and do not stop all at once.
Stand facing a wall with the back heel down and lean forward gently. Keep the stretch mild and do not bounce.
Hold a wall, gently pull one heel toward the seat, and stand tall. Keep the knees close and do not arch the low back.
Place a forearm on a door frame and step through gently. Keep the stretch mild and do not force the shoulder back.
Sit or stand, hinge from the hips with a long back, and stop at a mild pull. Do not bounce or round hard through the spine.
Place one ankle on the opposite knee and lean forward slightly with a long back. Do not twist or torque the bent knee.
Pull one arm across the chest with the shoulders down. Keep the stretch gentle and the neck relaxed.
Raise light dumbbells out to the sides to about shoulder height, then lower slowly. Keep a soft elbow and do not swing.
Pull a band toward the face with the elbows high, then return slowly. Squeeze the upper back and do not shrug.
Sit or lie with the leg straight and tighten the thigh to press the back of the knee down, then relax. Hold a gentle squeeze, not a painful one.
Rise onto the balls of both feet, then lower slowly. Stand tall and use a wall for balance if needed.
With a band around the legs, take controlled steps forward, back, or slightly out. Keep a soft knee bend and the knees tracking over the feet.
Step one foot out and back while the arms move up and down, with no jump. This is a low-impact pulse raiser for the warm-up.
Lie on the side with the knees stacked and rotate the top arm open through the upper back. Keep the hips still.
Reach one hand down the back and gently assist at the elbow. Keep the ribs down and the stretch mild.
Reach the arms forward and let the upper back round slightly while you breathe. Keep the stretch gentle and the neck relaxed.
